snapshot.title: Planet Hunters visual identity: Earth base hub branding and star field background
snapshot.description: The main hub (earth_base_1.tscn / earth_launchpad.tscn) has no Planet Hunters identity. There is no wordmark, no star field, nothing that says 'you are in a sci-fi citizen science game'. This hurts first impressions significantly given the 'looks good' requirement. Needs to feel like a space game, not a generic top-down base.
